assumptions_resolved: The agreement tests could have been written as byte-for-byte fixtures. They were not, because a fixture makes every rewording a failure and trains its maintainer to update the fixture without reading the change. Asserting the FACT instead means the prose stays editable and the promise stays enforced.

AGENTS.md is held by open pull requests 2821 and 2607. That is not a collision under this repository's rule: scripts/check-pr-source-collisions.mjs protects exactly one path, scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs, which this pull request does not touch. The AGENTS.md edit is one self-contained paragraph inside the #2301 task-router entry, chosen to minimise textual overlap with those branches.

The reviewer noted it could not execute commands and so treated the STATUS evidence as unverified. It was verified here against git history: 1dcf196e is 'Merge pull request #3000 from u2giants/claude/2301-step3-tombstones', 0a11c42d is '#3010 ... claude/2301-step4-capacity-preview', and 95e1ac95 is '#3013 ... claude/2301-step5-hourly-audit'.

The STATUS table now records Steps 3, 4 and 5 with their merge commits, guarded-merge heads, implementation commits and sub-issues, so the next reader does not have to reconstruct what landed from git history.

The abandonment audit issue claims no database object. Its fence carries empty writes: and reads: on purpose -- claiming the object would collide with the very claim the audit exists to investigate -- and it is routed as repo-maintenance, not shared-db-orchestrator, because the lane CLI refuses that pairing. The template test pins all four fence lines, so nobody later 'fixes' the empty lists or the route.
The canonical ai-devops orchestrator skill half of this step is a separate synchronized change in popcre/ai-devops, not a hand edit of the installed copy.
